GOAL: Make POST /api/auth/logout idempotency replay exact-request/principal bound so a reused key cannot produce false-success or cross-action replay.
SCOPE: persistence/schema only if exact replay binding cannot be represented safely with existing immutable audit fields
REQUIRED_BEHAVIOR: Same key + same authenticated session/principal + same revoke_all semantics may return the prior accepted result.
Same key + different session/principal must not be treated as the current request's prior success.
Same key + different revoke_all semantics must not replay across AUTH_LOGOUT and AUTH_LOGOUT_ALL.
Idempotent retry after the original session was revoked must remain possible for the exact original request.
CSRF, device binding, RBAC, persistence fail-closed behavior, and audit evidence remain intact.
TEST_MATRIX: exact same request retry after successful single-session logout -> 200 prior success
same key different live session -> no false-success; current session remains subject to requested logout semantics or conflict
same key different principal -> no false-success
same key single logout then revoke_all=true -> no cross-action replay
same key revoke_all=true then single logout -> no cross-action replay
device mismatch -> denied before accepting replay
FORBIDDEN_BEHAVIOR: Do not solve by disabling logout idempotency.
Do not mutate NEXY.AI-Test-AI directly while worker-isolation policy is structurally blocked.
UNBLOCK_CONDITION: Authoritative policy establishes a Git-valid isolated worker namespace or explicitly authorizes an equivalent isolation mechanism.
